name: Porsche 911 GT3 R (992, 2026) - The Bend Manthey #92
_notes: Visuals, layout.json and textures are generated by Tools/External/LMU/import_lmu_vehicle.py from the Le Mans Ultimate 992 GT3 R (2026 EVO) with the 92_26_Manthey_WEC livery.

From the LMU physics files (992GT3R-24.hdv / _Engine.ini): mass 1332 kg (no fuel), 56% rear, inertia, rev limit 9400 rpm, full-throttle and closed-throttle torque tables (LMGT3 balance of performance, 430 Nm @ 8500 rpm), 6-speed sequential tooth counts (43/15, 40/18, 36/20, 33/22, 31/24, 34/30, final 39/16 x 23/15), 9000 rpm upshift, clutch torque, diff preload/power/coast, spring and anti-roll bar settings, 20.3 deg steering lock, brake bias.

Derived: CoM height = hdv CGHeight 0.273 m above the floor + 0.087 m floor clearance; spring rates are the hdv default setting x SpringMult; engine friction is a linear fit of the closed-throttle column; engine inertia includes the clutch.

Tires and aero are generated by Tools/External/LMU/export_lmu_physics.py from the car's .tbc tire (compound 0 "Medium") and .hdv aero map: tires.json holds the slip curves, load sensitivity, peak slip, camber and speed effects, aero.json the front/rear wing, body and diffuser maps. Default setup used: front wing 0, rear wing 11.3 deg, ride heights 0.050/0.066 m, tire pressures 136 kPa, camber -3.0/-3.4 deg.

Estimated (not in the LMU data used here): damper rates at 0.45/0.75 of critical, suspension travel, wheel inertias and brake torque magnitude (full pedal ~2.6 g, keeping the hdv 60/40 force split). Not modelled: tire temperature, pressure grip, wear, wet grip, pneumatic trail / aligning torque, tire vertical compliance, aero rotation damping, drafting, flaps and fenders.
